description: This file defines the LaserTrails class responsible for managing laser pointer trails, including local and collaborative trails, in a drawing application. It handles trail rendering, updates based on collaborator actions, and integrates with animation frame handling.

classes.name: LaserTrails
classes.description: Manages laser pointer trails for local and collaborative users, including trail creation, updates, and rendering.

methods.name: getTrailOptions
methods.description: Returns configuration options for trail appearance and decay based on pressure and length.

methods.name: startPath
methods.description: Begins a new trail path at specified coordinates.

methods.name: addPointToPath
methods.description: Adds a point to the current trail path.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts trail rendering within a specified SVG container.

methods.name: onFrame
methods.description: Called on each animation frame to update collaborative trails.

methods.name: updateCollabTrails
methods.description: Updates the state of collaborative trails based on current collaborator data.
